project_name.justification: The text announces that Carlyle has acquired the 'Quesnel Gold Project'. The title of the press release is 'Carlyle Issues Quesnel Property Option Shares and Acquires Quesnel Gold Property'.

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified at the start of the press release: 'CARLYLE COMMODITIES CORP. (CSE: CCC) (FSE: BJ4) (OTC Pink: CCCFF) ("Carlyle" or the "Company") announces that...'

ceo_buyer.justification: The press release is signed off by 'Morgan Good Chief Executive Officer'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The text states: 'The Company, having satisfied the terms of the Option, has acquired an undivided 100% right, title and interest in the Quesnel Gold Project.'

primary_commodity.justification: The project is explicitly named the 'Quesnel Gold Project'.

verified_article_link.justification: The article at this link is titled 'Carlyle Issues Quesnel Property Option Shares and Acquires Quesnel Gold Property', which directly pertains to the project of interest.

currency.justification: The acquiring company, Carlyle Commodities Corp., is listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE), and the transaction values are denoted with a '$' symbol, implying Canadian Dollars. 'CARLYLE COMMODITIES CORP. (CSE: CCC)... at a deemed price of $0.05 per Share...'

cash_payments_raw.justification: The acquisition was completed via the issuance of shares. A $1,000,000 cash payment is mentioned, but it is for a future, optional purchase of 1% of the royalty, not for the initial acquisition: 'Carlyle may, at any time, purchase 1% of the royalty on the Quesnel Gold Project from the Optionor for a cash payment in the aggregate amount of $1,000,000.'

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms were provided as a number of shares and a price per share, which falls under the 'Calculable Share Value' priority. Therefore, this field is null.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: No single combined cash and share value was provided for the transaction.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The text states that Carlyle 'has issued 2,000,000 common shares (each, a "Share") at a deemed price of $0.05 per Share to Divitiae Resources Ltd.'

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No warrants were mentioned as part of the Quesnel project acquisition. The warrants mentioned in the text relate to the separate acquisition of Miramis Mining Corp.

option_payments_raw.justification: No stock options were issued as payment for the Quesnel project acquisition.

issued_share_price.justification: The text states the shares were issued 'at a deemed price of $0.05 per Share'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: There is no mention of an exploration commitment in terms of meters of drilling.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: There is no mention of a monetary exploration commitment for the Quesnel project.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The acquisition is subject to a royalty retained by the seller: 'subject to a 2% net smelter return royalty to be retained by the Optionor.'

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text states the project is 'covering 1,607.34 hectares'.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The text states the project is 'covering 1,607.34 hectares'.

resource_size.justification: The text mentions the project is 'on trend with the historic "G-South" historical gold resource' but does not provide a quantified mineral resource estimate for the Quesnel project itself.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are provided in the first line of the press release: 'CARLYLE COMMODITIES CORP. (CSE: CCC)'.
